summary: A 1939 newspaper item lists Cap Mountain in Helena National Forest among points where a need was shown; no lookout history found. Story held.

events.note: Newspaper item of July 26, 1939 (Sanders County Independent), as quoted by the Forest Lookouts index, lists Cap Mountain among points where a need had been shown

evidence.supports: Cap Mountain is in Lewis and Clark County, Helena National Forest

notes_for_editor: NO STORY WRITTEN (held). The only source is the Forest Lookouts Montana index entry, which quotes a 1939 Sanders County Independent item. That item says a need had been shown for 'points', not that a lookout was built, staffed or used. The index also lists non-tower entries (for example Federal Building under Lewis and Clark County), so the listing alone does not establish a lookout. No source found on build, builder, staffing, fate or the site today. Not on the FFLOS Montana Lewis and Clark list (firelookout.org; no Cap Mountain row). Natural Atlas page gave no readable text; AllTrails returned 403. Searches used: 2. Reconsider if a source shows a structure on the mountain.
